source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    LedgerAR.Wbs1, 
    LedgerAR.invoice,
    LedgerAR.taxcode,
    LedgerAR.TransType,
    LedgerAR.TransDate,
    LedgerAR.SubType,
    LedgerAR.AutoEntry,
    LedgerAR.Period,
    LedgerAR.EmOrg,
    AR.InvoiceDate, 
    AR.DueDate,
    AR.LinkCompany,
    PR.ClientID,
    PR.WBS1,
    PR.BillingContactID,
    PR.billingClientID,
    PR.Sublevel,
    PR.BillingContactID,
    
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN LedgerAR.taxcode IS NULL 
                THEN CASE 
                        WHEN LedgerAR.TransType = 'IN' THEN -amount 
                        ELSE CASE WHEN LedgerAR.TransType = 'CR' AND LedgerAR.SubType = 'T' THEN -amount 
                             ELSE amount END
                    END 
            ELSE 0.0 
        END
    ) AS WBS1InvoiceBal 
FROM 
    LedgerAR
    INNER JOIN AR ON AR.WBS1 = LedgerAR.WBS1 AND AR.WBS2 = LedgerAR.WBS2 AND AR.WBS3 = LedgerAR.WBS3 AND AR.Invoice = LedgerAR.Invoice 
    INNER JOIN PR ON AR.WBS1 = PR.WBS1 AND PR.WBS2 = ' ' AND PR.WBS3 = ' ' 
    INNER JOIN PR AS LEVEL2 ON AR.WBS1 = LEVEL2.WBS1 AND AR.WBS2 = LEVEL2.WBS2 AND LEVEL2.WBS3 = ' ' 
    INNER JOIN PR AS LEVEL3 ON AR.WBS1 = LEVEL3.WBS1 AND AR.WBS2 = LEVEL3.WBS2 AND LEVEL3.WBS3 = AR.WBS3 
     
WHERE 
    AR.WBS1 = LedgerAR.WBS1 
    AND AR.WBS2 = LedgerAR.WBS2 
    AND AR.WBS3 = LedgerAR.WBS3 
    AND AR.Invoice = LedgerAR.Invoice 
    AND (
        (LedgerAR.TransType = 'IN' AND (LedgerAR.SubType <> 'X' OR LedgerAR.SubType IS NULL))
        OR (LedgerAR.TransType = 'CR' AND LedgerAR.SubType IN ('R', 'T'))
    ) 
    AND LedgerAR.AutoEntry = 'N' 
    AND amount <> 0 
    AND (
        (SUBSTRING(LEVEL3.Org, 1, 3) LIKE '0%')
        AND (LEVEL2.Sublevel = 'N' OR LEVEL3.WBS3 > ' ')
    ) 
    AND (
        LedgerAR.TransType = 'IN' 
        AND (
          LedgerAR.SubType <> 'X' 
          OR LedgerAR.SubType Is Null
        ) 
        OR (
          LedgerAR.TransType = 'CR' 
          AND LedgerAR.SubType IN ('R', 'T')
        )
    ) 
    AND LedgerAR.AutoEntry = 'N' 
    AND LedgerAR.Period >= 0 
    AND AR.linkCompany IS NULL 
GROUP BY 
    LedgerAR.Wbs1, 
    LedgerAR.invoice,
    LedgerAR.taxcode,
    LedgerAR.TransType,
    LedgerAR.TransDate,
    LedgerAR.SubType,
    LedgerAR.AutoEntry,
    LedgerAR.Period,
    LedgerAR.EmOrg,
    AR.InvoiceDate, 
    AR.DueDate,
    AR.LinkCompany,
    PR.ClientID,
    PR.WBS1,
    PR.BillingContactID,
    PR.billingClientID,
    PR.Sublevel,
    PR.BillingContactID;
